column1: # tests/exec/XFAIL.tsv — cases known to fail, with the reason.
# The pattern is a shell glob matched against the case id (path under
# tests/exec/, no .pie). Keep entries here instead of annotating cases so the
# known-broken set is reviewable in one place.
# A case listed here that STARTS PASSING is reported as XPASS and fails the
# suite — that is the signal to delete its line. Do not leave stale entries.
# See A2A/from_agent3.md for the full diagnosis behind each reason.

column2: Runtime hangs at O0/O1/O2/O3 (>2 s) in this allocation/printing fixture; the allocation/index-loop kernel alone returns 42. Full root cause not yet isolated (Agent-4 §36).
Runtime hangs at O0/O1/O2/O3 (>2 s) in this scalar-loop/printing fixture; the scalar sum kernel alone returns 2450 mod 256. Full root cause not yet isolated (Agent-4 §36).
Runtime hangs at all tiers; its i += 1 does not advance beyond 1. Independently reduced to n3_compound_loop (Agent-4 §§36,49); array/I/O defects may remain after that is fixed.
Compiler crashes (rc 139), emitting no binary, at O0/O1/O2/O3 in this mutable-global/printing fixture. Root cause not yet minimized (Agent-4 §36).
PEAR v0.9.1 only bypasses clause matching for a single expression body; block-bodied tuple clause reads unbound values and returns 0 instead of 42 at all four tiers.
